title: The Handoff Doc Trick That Keeps Claude Code Sharp
description:
Most people don't know what a handoff doc is, and it's the single biggest miss I see in how people use Claude Code.

Here's how it works. When your Claude Code thread starts to slow down or get dumber, that's context running out. Ask Claude to summarize everything you just did in that thread. Take that summary and drop it into a brand new chat as the first message. Your new thread picks up exactly where the old one left off, with fresh context. It performs like the first prompt you ever sent it.

This is one of the most useful prompts in my whole Claude Code workflow.

#claudecode #ai
transcript: I just heard something that is going to make my head explode. I just learned that there is a huge amount of people who do not know what handoff docs are or have never used a handoff doc. So, what this is is when your AI starts to run out of context, meaning it's not performing the same, it's just used a lot of information, you need to use something called a handoff doc. So, what you can do is you can ask your AI to summarize everything that you just did in that thread, and then you can use that summary to send to your other AI threads. That way your AI threads can talk to each other in a more efficient way, and you can pick up where you just left off in another thread with new context, which means your AI thread is going to perform so much better.
